newsitem.title: USA: US Rep. LaFalce recommended for Dem. banking spot.
newsitem.headline: US Rep. LaFalce recommended for Dem. banking spot.

text.p: Congressman John LaFalce will be recommended by the House Democratic Steering and Policy Committee for the position of ranking Democrat on the House Banking Committee on Wednesday, Congressional aides said.
The steering committee voted late Tuesday to recommend that current Banking Committee ranking member Rep. Henry Gonzalez, D-Texas, take an emeritus title, aides said.

LaFalce, D-NY, and Rep. Bruce Vento, D-Minn., challenged Gonzalez for the top Democratic spot on the Banking Committee. Gonzalez was chairman of the committee 1989-1994 when Democrats controlled the House.
The steering committee was presenting its recommendations for leaders to House Democrats, who were to vote on them Wednesday.
If Gonzalez rejects the emeritus title, then a vote would be taken on whether he should stay ranking Democrat on the Banking Committee, aides said.

If Gonzalez did not win a majority on that vote then there would be another vote for the candidates for the Banking Committee position, possibly including a run-off between the top two vote getters, aides said.
